.. py:function:: async_setup_platform(hass, config, async_add_entities, discovery_info=None)
   :async:


   Old way of setting up Hue lights.

   Can only be called when a user accidentally mentions hue platform in their
   config. But even in that case it would have been ignored.


.. py:function:: create_light(item_class, coordinator, bridge, is_group, rooms, api, item_id)

.. py:function:: hue_brightness_to_hass(value)

   Convert hue brightness 1..254 to hass format 0..255.

   .. py:property:: unique_id

      Return the unique ID of this Hue light.


   .. py:property:: device_id

      Return the ID of this Hue light.


   .. py:property:: name

      Return the name of the Hue light.


   .. py:property:: brightness

      Return the brightness of this light between 0..255.


   .. py:property:: color_mode
      :type: str


      Return the color mode of the light.


   .. py:property:: _color_mode

      Return the hue color mode.


   .. py:property:: hs_color

      Return the hs color value.


   .. py:property:: color_temp_kelvin
      :type: int | None


      Return the color temperature value in Kelvin.


   .. py:property:: max_color_temp_kelvin
      :type: int


      Return the coldest color_temp_kelvin that this light supports.


   .. py:property:: min_color_temp_kelvin
      :type: int


      Return the warmest color_temp_kelvin that this light supports.


   .. py:property:: is_on

      Return true if device is on.


   .. py:property:: available

      Return if light is available.


   .. py:property:: effect

      Return the current effect.


   .. py:property:: effect_list

      Return the list of supported effects.


   .. py:property:: device_info
      :type: homeassistant.helpers.device_registry.DeviceInfo | None


      Return the device info.

      :async:


      Turn the specified or all lights on.



   .. py:method:: async_turn_off(**kwargs)
      :async:
